_comment: Cast roles and per-engine voice tables. Voice ids are PLACEHOLDERS to be confirmed by listening (and, for ElevenLabs/Gemini, replaced with the author's chosen library/designed voices). API plugins also read overrides from env: <ENGINE>_VOICE_<ROLE>, e.g. ELEVENLABS_VOICE_NARRATOR. Roles: narrator, male_old, male_young, female, divine, extra.

role_descriptions.narrator: mature, low, steady storyteller; carries all attribution and description
role_descriptions.male_old: Kestutis: weathered elder, tired restraint, gravel
role_descriptions.male_young: Vytautas / Jogaila: tense younger man, controlled anger
role_descriptions.female: Birute: grave, intuitive woman, can break into anguish
role_descriptions.divine: Amber Queen / Praurime: not human, vast, calm, slightly processed

elevenlabs._note: Legacy premade voice ids (George, Callum, Daniel, Sarah, Matilda, Brian) as placeholders; they speak English natively, so for Lithuanian pick Lithuanian-accent library voices or design voices and override via ELEVENLABS_VOICE_<ROLE>.

google_chirp._note: Voice-name pattern <locale>-Chirp3-HD-<Name> is from the vendor docs; which of the 30 names are offered for lt-LT was not confirmed. Run the voices.list call and edit.

omnivoice._note: OmniVoice voice-design attributes (gender, age, pitch, style=whisper). Voice design is trained on zh/en only; for lt, cloning from a same-language reference clip (OMNIVOICE_REF_<ROLE>=path.wav + _TEXT) is the stable mode.

higgs._note: Zero-shot voice cloning needs reference clips: HIGGS_REF_<ROLE>=path.wav with HIGGS_REF_<ROLE>_TEXT. Consent-only references.

chatterbox._note: Per-role reference clips via CHATTERBOX_REF_<ROLE>=path.wav (consented voices only).
